description: Latency-distribution statistics. Pure static methods on long[] sample arrays: percentiles, log2-spaced CDF histograms, jitter score, tail analysis (CTE / Hill index / fatness ratio), robust statistics (IQR / MAD / CoV / skew / kurtosis), KS distribution comparison, Cohen's d effect size, and bootstrap confidence intervals. Zero-dependency. Byte-equivalent to the Rust sibling subms-stats crate.
